correctness.rationale: Stationarity of H(z) for arbitrary smooth H gives E[xy|z]=bz. Exact derivative (x²+s w²)/2 has σ(xy−x²−s w²), yielding E[x²]+sE[w²]=bm. Derivative balances of y²/2 and z²/2 eliminate E[xyz] and give E[y²]+b Var(z)=bm(r−m). Since b,r>0 this implies 0≤m≤r; m=0 forces y=z=x=w=0 on invariant support, whereas m=r would require dot z=−br while support sits at y=0,z=r, impossible. Conditional orthogonality yields Var(xy)=b² Var(z)+E dot z² and Cov(z,xy)=b Var(z), with correlation only for positive Var(z).
